## What happened

- [ ] Other:

## How many sessions

How far into growing your PAI were you when this friction appeared?

- [ ] First session (planting)
- [ ] Sessions 2-5 (early growth)
- [ ] Sessions 5-20 (bough formation)
- [ ] Beyond 20 sessions (established tree)

What should have happened instead?

## What you tried

Any workarounds you attempted and whether they helped.

## Suggestion

If you have an idea for how the seed should change, describe it here. Reference real operational experience -- "I found that..." is more useful than "It would be better if...".
